intro.text: A teenage thief on the streets of Yeddaw, well known to the city's urchins.

items.text: Caught stealing fruit in a Yeddaw market, Tiqqa ran straight into the man Lift was following, who seized her. When she drew a knife, he disarmed her and killed her with his Shardblade in front of everyone, saying the law demanded death for attacking an officer with a blade.
Lift tried to heal her, but it was too late, and Wyndle explained that Shardblade wounds were especially hard to heal. Lift vowed to remember Tiqqa and angrily went after her killer.
